from_notes: Roughage does not provide any nutrients to our body but helps our body get rid of undigested food.
x: Roughage (dietary fibre) is indigestible plant carbohydrate: it gives no energy or nutrients but adds bulk and helps the body get rid of undigested food (prevents constipation). Energy comes from carbohydrates and fats, body building from proteins, and vitamins from food itself – not from roughage.
